stories.headline: Former Anthropic researcher to testify on AI risks
stories.summary: Jacob Coxon is expected to testify at a New York City Council hearing as lawmakers consider AI-safety bills. Reuters could not independently verify Bloomberg's report; Coxon has accused leading labs of taking reckless risks.

stories.headline: China's LOGINK shipping-data platform fades
stories.summary: Reuters found the state-backed logistics platform's global partnerships stalled and its Wenzhou hub apparently abandoned. US pressure coincided with the retreat, but Reuters could not establish why the project abruptly went dark.

stories.headline: US employment is full but less dynamic
stories.summary: Unemployment is 4.2% and layoffs remain low, but hiring, workforce growth and inflation-adjusted income gains are weak. Reuters says the mixed picture helps explain poor voter sentiment ahead of November's midterms.

stories.headline: Spain calls snap election for November 29
stories.summary: Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez called an early vote after parliament rejected housing decrees. His Socialists trail in most polls, making the election a high-risk attempt to break legislative deadlock.

stories.headline: Oil bottlenecks persist despite export rebound
stories.summary: Hormuz crude flows recovered to nearly 80% of prewar levels, but record tanker rates, insurance costs and lost refining capacity keep prices elevated. The analysis is Reuters commentary, not a supply forecast.
